format: mp3 (MPEG-1 Layer III, LAME VBR, 44.1 kHz) - decodable by decodeAudioData in Chromium, Firefox and Safari
notes: gain = suggested base gain (linear) for the mixer; files are normalised per category (peak for weapons/impacts, active-RMS for voices/loops).

Loops: play with source.loop=true, loopStart/loopEnd (seconds). The file carries 0.25s of periodic padding on both sides, so the loop stays seamless whether or not the browser trims the MP3 encoder delay.
Mono files are positional one-shots; stereo files are non-positional beds.
Nobody has listened to these files; QC was by signal analysis only (see scripts/audio/report.md).
